answer_1.quote: In conversational AI, undesirable behaviors in agent responses, such as logical inconsistencies or deficiencies in social competence, are commonly referred to as errors. Preventing such errors from reaching users during deployment is essential...
answer_1.outputs: error detection and definition in dialogue contexts

answer_2.quote: Evaluation Metrics We evaluate performance using the H-Score, the harmonic mean of accuracy on classes included and excluded during training (i.e., known and unknown error types), denoted Acc-K and Acc-U. For measuring the cluster quality in encoder-based approaches, we use the ARI and NMI scores.
